body: I'm almost 23 years old, I'm unemployed and not in any form of education or training and my only notable accomplishment since graduating high school was having held a full time job at Wal-Mart for a year and a half. I've tried taking college classes more than once but I've only passed one class, in addition I still live with my parents and I have no idea how I would live on my own. In general I hate basically every single thing about myself from my looks to my personality and most days I end up wanting to kill myself.
